description: This file defines the EmployeeEmergencyContactsController class within the OrangeHRM system, intended to handle requests related to employee emergency contacts in the HRM plugin module. It manages the rendering of emergency contact components and permission handling based on employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeEmergencyContactsController
classes.description: Controller class handling employee emergency contact views and data permission checks, extending BaseViewEmployeeController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the component to display emergency contact info for a specific employee, based on the 'empNumber' extracted from the request; sets permissions or handles bad requests.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data group identifiers used to verify employee capability to view emergency contacts.
